critical_code_review_comments: connectors.py _sync_connection: the fallback event insertion path uses `if not ev_docs and (mem_docs or True):` which is always true — the `or True` makes the condition redundant/misleading. Consider removing `or True` so a no-op sync (no digest change already handled earlier) truly doesn't emit noise events. Not a functional bug in current flow but a code-quality wart.

connectors.py list_providers uses `async for a in db.integration_accounts.find(...)` inside a dict comprehension using `{a['provider']: a async for a in ...}` — correct in Python 3.11, but note the resulting dict is over-fetched (no projection benefits realized because tokens are excluded but full docs still shipped).

OTP email delivery to @example.com fails against Resend in prod (ValidationError logged). OTP_TEST_MODE=1 still returns dev_code so tests work, but log noise is high. Consider suppressing the Resend send when OTP_TEST_MODE=1 to keep logs clean.
passlib bcrypt.__about__ AttributeError startup warning is pre-existing (per review instructions to ignore); worth a bcrypt/passlib pin bump in future.
